subject.title: Feature: Add costCurrency config option to customize cost display currency

question: Should OpenClaw add a public non-USD currency contract for local model-cost estimates, and should that contract live per provider/model or as a global display preference?
rationale: Current local pricing is explicitly USD-shaped across config, persistence, status, and docs, while provider-reported billing already has typed units; adding `costCurrency` would change public config and accounting/display semantics rather than fix a narrow bug.

options.title: Design a currency contract first
options.body: Define a single canonical currency shape for configured local estimates, update schema/docs/status/UI together, and require upgrade/default behavior proof.

options.title: Keep local estimates USD-only
options.body: Leave configured model pricing as USD and point non-USD users to provider billing units or external conversion until maintainers want a broader accounting model.

options.title: Track broader footer work
options.body: Fold this request into the broader customizable cost/balance/rate-limit status work if maintainers prefer one UX decision surface.

recommendation.title: Design a currency contract first
recommendation.body: Define a single canonical currency shape for configured local estimates, update schema/docs/status/UI together, and require upgrade/default behavior proof.
